About this fixture

Clean Fixture Site is published at https://clean.example.com/. It is a deliberately correct static build used by the siteseo test suite. A checker that reports problems everywhere is as useless as one that reports none, so this build guards the false-positive side while the broken fixture guards the other.

This page is deliberately correct. The test suite asserts that auditing this build produces no findings at error severity, which is the other half of the broken fixture's job.

What it proves

A checker that reports problems everywhere is as useless as one that reports none. This fixture guards the false-positive side.

Back to the fixture home page

Every page here declares a unique title, a unique meta description, exactly one h1, a self-referencing canonical, and images carrying width and height attributes. The sitemap lists only canonical URLs that return a successful response, and robots.txt names that sitemap.

Read the sample post for the structured data example.
